target_customer: Engineering and environmental consultancies in the US and UK that write technical reports
problem: Consultants spend long hours drafting transportation, noise, air quality, flood risk and environmental reports for construction projects. SchemeFlow generates first drafts with AI.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to engineering firms, web app and Microsoft Word add-in
product_category: AI technical report generation for engineering and environmental review

founders.name: Andrew Browning
prior_employers: Mayor's Office Birmingham UK (Chief of Staff)
education: University of Cambridge, St John's College, Starred First

founders.name: James Griffith
education: University of Cambridge, Engineering, First Class

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs retrieval over regulations and project data, structured report templates per discipline and jurisdiction, and Word integration; domain depth is the hard part more than model research.

defensibility.rationale: Template libraries per local regulation, firm-specific report history and SOC 2 raise switching costs, though foundation models make drafting copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No dated evidence that consultancies or software vendors built a competing report drafter near 2024; customers are the consultancies themselves.

market_need_then: The YC description sizes report writing at 143k US consultants times $64k a year; the company's founders include a construction engineer and say LLMs made local regulatory handling feasible. Cambridge coverage cites over 4,000 reports generated, claim unverified.

brand_strength.rationale: Launch coverage on the YC blog and a Cambridge engineering profile, but nothing about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: SchemeFlow is an active YC S24 company selling AI report drafting to engineering consultancies, with named customers across the UK and US and a Cambridge profile citing thousands of reports. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found; funding beyond YC could not be verified.
notes: Funding conflicts and is unverified: Standout $625K, CB Insights and Startup-seeker about $870K with Transpose Platform, ETCapital and DTX Ventures, VCBacked $500K pre-seed in 2024-09. No round recorded. The YC long description says two brothers and a high school friend; sources found do not confirm the family link beyond the shared surname, and CB Insights lists an additional founder, Eric Yeow, not on the YC page. Jonny Browning education not found. Competitor search found no dated 2024 entrants, so the list is empty.
